## Description

Go long low-beta assets and short high-beta assets, scaled to reduce net market beta.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon factor portfolios when high-beta assets are expensive relative to low-beta assets.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short, smart-beta and factor funds; analogous studies in other asset classes.

## Required data

Point-in-time returns/beta estimates, asset universe, borrowing costs, financing rates and rebalance data.

## Caveats

Leverage and shorting are central; financing constraints can undermine the theoretical result.
